source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Organisers and players can use the layouts from Games Workshop events in every game with the latest Chapter Approved Mission Deck. The Warhammer Studio made them to create risk-and-reward choices tied to each player's objectives.

Each pairing of Primary Missions has 3 layouts, A, B and C. Players use the one the organiser names, or pick one at random if the organiser directs.

detail.pack: most recent Chapter Approved Mission Deck
detail.designAim: risk-and-reward decisions tied to each player's objectives
detail.selection: as the organiser directs: the layout specified, or one chosen at random
